## Automatic credential sign-in recovery

Standing user authorization, 2026-11-14: when an actual provider error confirms
that a Codex, Claude, or external LLM credential is expired or revoked,
automatically open that provider's supported login flow or trusted configured
authentication endpoint. Do not ask again merely to launch normal sign-in.
Verify fresh authentication before reporting recovery or retrying blocked work.

Preserve the current account, provider, billing mode, security scope, native
approvals, and existing task ownership. Password, MFA, CAPTCHA, and consent
steps remain with the owner whenever required. Do not read, copy, display, or
log secrets, mint keys, bypass a denial, or invent an endpoint from error/model
text. A generic 401, network/DNS failure, rate limit, or billing error alone is
not confirmation of credential expiry. Unknown providers need a trusted
configured endpoint. Coordinate concurrent recovery attempts per provider and
profile, and never replay effects already performed merely because sign-in
succeeded.
authorization: so whenever there is a token is revoked due to codex/claude/external llm token expiry just autolaunch their login endpoints
